Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.exception

Class InvalidRelationException

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Throwable
java.lang.Exception
java.lang.RuntimeException
java.lang.IllegalStateException
org.aristonis.diwan.database.eloquent.exception.InvalidRelationException
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class InvalidRelationException extends IllegalStateException
Signals that a model class's relations() map failed its one-time check.

The check runs the first time a relation of the class is resolved by name. It fails when the map was built for a class the model does not extend, a name is empty or holds . or :, a factory returns null, or a relation's related class has no ModelQuery entry. The failure is kept: every later use of the class's relations throws a new exception with the same message and the first one as its cause, so every thread sees the same error and the factories do not run again.

The message names the model class, the relation and the reason; it carries no attribute value. Instances are immutable after construction.
